title: Independently check four frame1094 native matrices
body:
## Result
Independently checks the complete new-frame1094 native footprint of frozen PR6353: three paid MOVE recipes and helper703's target normalizer, at tensor width one, including absolute phase.

Two implementations agree on all **2,048 columns and 1,048,576 complex coefficient positions**. The four exact matrices have 26,624 nonzero entries. The primary uses closed Gaussian chart kernels and finite convolution; the separate oracle uses dense P/D/C circuits. Neither scientific consumer imports the compiler, author checker or the other consumer. An authenticated producer independently binds all recipes to source bytes.

This adds source-specific finite implementation evidence. The predecessor signed-Pauli-plus-phase criterion was already logically complete. No generic/all-width compiler theorem, supplier/κ admission, physical caller/erasure/funding result, or selected-frontier change is claimed. All five framework assumptions remain.

## Evidence
- Six registered Python3.12 normal/optimized producer/checker commands pass.
- Concrete global-phase, column-zero-preserving phase and child-rank/direction faults expose unequal coefficients.
- Read-only package-only Git-free/empty-PATH replay and source/recipe/typed-receipt rejection controls are recorded in VALIDATION.md.
- Exact committed bytes/modes, declared source ancestry and a self-contained export are checked separately.

Hosted CI and human acceptance are separate checks. Exact commands, receipts, mathematical proof, source pins and remaining obligations are in `research/p104-frame1094-native-columns`.

## Coordination and credit
Refines supplier-boundary-audit to one four-case footprint, taking [handoff19343965](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19343965). [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19344079). Complements rational PR6355 and finite-invoice PR6359 without stacking their branches.

Source6353 stays db2a20bc50bc7a8a4db931af85ce7f012ae7c3c3; canonical main refreshed at7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority8, selected6030 unchanged. Full325-open-PR non-atomic pagination and visible handoffs rechecked; bounded coverage is not a novelty certificate.

Construction/compiler/native-chart credit stays with Ali Romman, Cinna Davis and the retained native-channel lineage, PR6349/6348/6350, DreamingOfClouds, the selected6030 independent audit by Douglas Colkitt with OpenAI Codex assistance, Matarener/PR5960, Clear1nsight and the complete retained NOTICE. New finite producer/independent implementations/proof review: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and three bounded agents. Same-session review is author-side evidence.

Next: actual caller endpoint/contacts and source-specific full funding/outer admission, or a separately bounded wider-width proof. No merge, closure or frontier change; maintainer edits disabled.
